summary: Iteration 5 - Backend + Frontend. Backend: 10/10 pytest tests pass including 2 new EMOM tests (schema + parsing 'EMOM 10 min: 10 pompes' returns mode=emom, sets≈10, reps='10', duration_seconds≈60). Existing modes (reps/time/amrap) still regress-pass. Frontend: verified EMOM plan editor (all 4 mode chips ex-mode-<id>-{reps,time,amrap,emom} present, EMOM shows fields 'Rounds (minutes)' / 'Reps / round' / 'Durée round (s)' / Notes, tapping EMOM on a reps exercise switches modes and persists to localStorage across save). Verified EMOM workout: mode badge 'EMOM' + '3 rounds × 3s · 5 reps' summary, 3 rows with ROUND N/M display and editable emom-reps-<i> TextInput, tapping play opens yellow (colors.warning) overlay labelled 'EMOM · ROUND 1/3', auto-chains to 'EMOM · ROUND 2/3' without a rest overlay, and closes normally after final round. Voice countdown verified via patched speechSynthesis: captured ["C'est parti !", 'Round 1', '2', '1', 'Round 2'] — 3-2-1 sequence and inter-round announce both fire, no crash on web. ImageManipulator compression in measurement/[id].tsx is correctly configured (resize width=900, JPEG compress=0.6, base64=true) — validated via code review as instructed. Session detail share text and card render EMOM as '{done}/{sets} rounds · {duration} par round' (verified via grep). Existing deprecated-warning noise from iter 4 still present (props.pointerEvents, Image style.resizeMode).

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning persists: 'Image: style.resizeMode is deprecated. Please use props.resizeMode.' Reference: emitted on app mount.
Console warning persists: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. Reference: emitted on app mount.

action_items: Optional cosmetic cleanup: silence residual RN deprecation warnings (Image.resizeMode, props.pointerEvents) — non-blocking.
critical_code_review_comments: workout/[id].tsx voice countdown at 3s durations only speaks '2' and '1' (never '3') because the interval decrements from 3→2 first — expected given the useEffect logic (next===10 || next<=3 && next>0). For real EMOM (60s) this is not visible but worth noting.

audio.ts calls Speech.stop() before every speak() which cancels overlapping calls — good for numeric countdown but means a slower speakGo('C'est parti !') could be cut short by an immediate 'Round 1' call. Currently not observed since speakGo runs on mount and Round 1 runs on play — fine.
measurement/[id].tsx: pickPhoto uses `mediaTypes: ['images']` which is the new correct API; ImageManipulator.manipulateAsync properly wrapped in try/catch with user-friendly Alert on failure. Good.
plan/[id].tsx MODE selector correctly sets sensible defaults per mode (EMOM: sets=10 default OR preserved, duration=60, rest=0). No leaked stale values between switches.
seed_data_creation: Seeded @ironflow/plans in localStorage with a HIIT plan containing an EMOM exercise (id=ex1, sets=3, duration=3s for fast timer chain test) + optional reps/time exercises.
context_for_next_testing_agent: EMOM works end-to-end. To reproduce workout timer chain: seed a plan with a low duration_seconds (e.g. 3s) EMOM exercise then hit toggle-set-0; overlay auto-chains rounds. Patch window.speechSynthesis.speak to capture voice calls (expo-speech routes through it on web). testIDs used: ex-mode-<exId>-{reps,time,amrap,emom}, emom-reps-<i>, toggle-set-<i>. Backend tests file: /app/backend/tests/test_ironflow_backend.py — reads EXPO_BACKEND_URL or EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no bugs found; all acceptance criteria (EMOM backend parsing, plan editor mode chip + fields, workout auto-chain overlay with warning color, voice countdown, photo compression, session detail EMOM rendering) verified.
